name: KiCad Track Gloss
description: Gloss one or more selected PCB tracks in a single click.
description_full: Real Spirit testing release for KiCad 10. The plugin treats selected routed copper as a taut polyline, contracts it against exact clearance obstacles, reconstructs clean 0/45/90 degree copper, repeats deterministic net passes to a fixed point or the total time budget, then performs one global KiCad DRC comparison when enabled. Selection authorizes modification; KiCad locks and native routing authority remain protected. A successful gloss is applied as one Undo operation and is never saved automatically. The diagnostic shows the board file and path, scope, outcome, gain, passes, total time, DRC state, and one primary reason; technical data remains available as JSON. The standalone adaptation was created by ChatGPT/Codex (OpenAI), inspired by and reusing part of DrAndyHaas's code, and is maintained by Frantz.
